findings.issue: The workflow triggers on any comment starting with '/fp' without verifying the identity or authorization level of the commenter. Because the 'record-false-positive' job is granted 'contents: write' permissions, an unauthorized user (e.g., an external contributor) could potentially trigger the underlying Python script to modify the repository's state or inject data into the metrics branch.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a check to the 'if' condition to verify that the commenter is an authorized collaborator or organization member, for example: && github.event.comment.author_association == 'COLLABORATOR'.
